items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Well, Perez and Kimball and a fella by name of Matoyer

ctx.x: Who were the better trumpet players around that time? Huh?

Who were the better trumpet players? Well, Perez and Kimball and a fella by name of Matoyer and those old men like Old Man and Morett, and fellas like that, you know, they were about the best men you could rely on, you know, if you hired them, if you had music, you could play, you see.
